sourceContracts.G58B: Scheduler chunk progress fusion: avoid intermediate RunState allocation while preserving exactly one original transition per fuel tick, quantum64 and public ABI. Generator source only.

requiredBeforeTiming: Committed source and behavioral regression inputs
Fresh canonical owned/CPS source generation where applicable
Same existing G44D1 LLVM21 split/O1 native seed producer completes parse/expand/check/emit

screeningPilot.unavailableCandidatePolicy: Keep its cells NOT_RUN; do not fabricate or replace samples. Independent runnable candidate can proceed in its original slots.
screeningPilot.triggerFullFollowup: Both checker-process-CPU paired ratios below1; geometric mean CPU ratio<=0.90; geometric mean checker-wall ratio<=1.00; no guardian or correctness failure. This is a cost filter, not significance or qualification.
screeningPilot.pairedUncertainty: Retain all raw ratios and Student95% intervals; n2 cannot qualify performance transfer or product promotion.

fullFollowup.earlyRejection: After first complete full pair, stop if checker-process-CPU ratio>=1; retain partial schedule explicitly.
requiresForRetainedWinner: Unchanged target emission byte comparison, separately from any candidate-self fixedpoint
If full effect remains promising, own-source byte-fixedpoint and existing semantic gates before integration claims
fullFollowup.productPromotion: Never infer original strict12, cluster/product matrices or accepted-compiler cutover from these limited pilots.

artifactPolicy: Required source inputs and compact receipts only in Git; generated images, profiles, AST transports, caches and bulk logs outside Git.
